name: Relevance
description: Measures how relevant the response is to the context and the previous message.

name: Engagement
description: Measures how well the response encourages further conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Measures how coherent the response is in the context of the conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Measures how creative and interesting the response is, including the use of interesting facts or unique perspectives.

name: Empathy
description: Measures how well the response demonstrates empathy and understanding towards the other person.
